description.narrative: The Department of Operational Support (DOS) provides operational support to all UN Secretariat entities, including advisory, operational and transactional support services and, where needed, exercises delegated authority on behalf of clients. DOS supports the entire UN Secretariat, consisting of almost 100 entities located around the globe. UNOPS offers technical support for DOS/OSCM for the Supply Chain Management Transition Initiative 2023-24.
